verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Moneybird itself. Its AI channel is an MCP server that lets external AI chats (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) reach the API, which is an adjacent integration rather than in-product insight. Duplicate-contact detection is a rule-based API feature with no evidence of AI. Accounting SaaS could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, so the axis applies and the verdict is none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
